Priya (AE): Heads up — Elysium Health wants a 6-month POC on private deployment (VPC + on-prem connectors). They asked for 30% off list on dedicated capacity (approx 2x A100 equiv). Start in ~3 weeks.

Lin (Sales Ops): @Priya what's the list price and expected consumption? Any compliance asks to justify deep discount? :thinking_face:

Priya (AE): List = $120k/mo for the reserved pool we scoped. POC term 6 months => list total $720k; 30% off => $504k. They want simple committed billing. Compliance: ISO27001 + data residency + KMS/HSM integration + audit logs.

Tom (AE Manager): 30% is large for 6mo. Need finance margin check and deal-desk approval. @deal-desk-bot open approval ticket and tag Legal for private deployment clauses.

deal-desk-bot: Approval ticket created: https://dd.redwood.internal/approvals/APP-7921 — requested by Priya. Reviewers: Sales Ops, Finance, Legal. SLA: 48h.

Lin (Sales Ops): Quick COGS estimate: infra+ops ≈ $35k/mo. Calc:
```
Monthly list: 120000
30% discount => 84000 customer monthly
COGS 35000 => margin ≈ (84000-35000)/84000 ≈ 58%\n```
Suggest counteroffer options.

Carmen (Legal): Private deployment + on-prem connectors = higher legal surface. Need DPA, limited liability for connector code, and KMS integration spec. Add security questionnaire to ticket. No signature until legal signs off.

Priya (AE): Customer insists procurement requires POC 'fully funded' via discount. They'll sign quickly if we accept 30%. Can we do 20% + expansion credit instead?

Tom (AE Manager): Try middle ground: 25% off for 6mo committed + $40k expansion credit applied toward their first enterprise order. That gives incentive to convert. @Lin run NPV and flag max concession.

Lin (Sales Ops): Quick numbers: 25% => $90k/mo => $540k for 6mo. $40k credit sits against expansion ARR. Margin improves slightly to ~60%. Recommend approval cap at 27% and require finance sign-off. Ops needs runbook for private deploy + HSM onboarding checklist.

Priya (AE): I'll propose 25% + $40k credit to the buyer and hold slot. They can sign in a week if ok.

deal-desk-bot: Approval status: PENDING (Sales Ops, Finance). Note: Legal review required pre-sign for private deployment and HSM terms.

Tom (AE Manager): @Carmen please prepare redlines focusing on DPA, liability cap for on-prem, KMS SLA, and rollback/canary terms. Priya: communicate counteroffer as 'conditional approval pending legal & finance'.

Priya (AE): On it. Pinged the buyer. Will update thread with their response. Thanks everyone :pray:
